claims.future_pass_claim_ceiling: development-only coupled radial shape compatibility conditional on spherical thermal hydrostatic equilibrium and three profiled shape nuisances per cluster-candidate

limitations: The mapping tests dimensionless radial shape only; absolute pressure, temperature, acceleration amplitude, and boundary pressure are not identified.

One shared boundary-shape parameter and two observable scales are profiled for every cluster and candidate or comparator, so a future pass is development-only coupled shape compatibility rather than an absolute prediction.
Spherical thermal hydrostatic equilibrium and zero nonthermal pressure are assumptions, and released diagonal errors are not a complete joint covariance.
The X-COP Newtonian control is gas-only; stellar profiles are not opened, and empirical RAR is not defined because absolute g_bar/a0 is unavailable under the predictor-only contract.
All local SPARC data and all eight X-COP objects remain development-only; no confirmation or publication claim survives.
No payload, nuisance fit, metric, score, selection, model call, or paid call exists in V3.

nuisance_contract.fit_method: evaluate the frozen zeta grid j/4096 for j=0..4096; at each zeta solve the one-column nonnegative weighted least-squares b_P and b_T analytically; minimize equal-observable loss and break exact ties by smaller zeta
nuisance_contract.matched_control_rule: every X-COP full candidate, X-COP ablation, gas-only Newtonian shape control, and uniform-acceleration shape control receives exactly the same three-parameter coupled profile; empirical RAR remains SPARC-only
nuisance_contract.per_cluster_identifiability_gate: require at least three pressure and three temperature bins and reject any zero-norm design before scoring

response_node_jacobian.bin_requirements: at least three pressure and three temperature response nodes within predictor support
response_node_jacobian.column_scaling: divide each nonzero Jacobian column by its Euclidean norm before SVD
response_node_jacobian.conditioning_evidence_timing: rank and condition pass/fail are computed only after authorized scoring at the response-fitted optimum; V3 contains no empirical conditioning evidence
response_node_jacobian.evaluation_point: the response-fitted frozen-grid optimum zeta,b_P,b_T for that cluster and formula; empirical conditioning therefore depends on observed responses through the fitted nuisance values
response_node_jacobian.failure_action: formula-cluster fit is structurally ineligible; retain the failure and do not use one object alone to prune a family
response_node_jacobian.generic_structural_rank_precheck: before fitting outcomes, require nonzero predictor-derived H variation at the authorized response-node radii, positive q, at least three nodes per observable, and algebraically distinct pressure-scale and temperature-scale columns; this establishes only generic rank possibility
response_node_jacobian.pre_score_claim: algorithm, equations, and thresholds are frozen; neither actual rank nor empirical conditioning has been observed
response_node_jacobian.threshold_origin: sqrt(binary64 machine epsilon) relative-rank floor and its reciprocal condition ceiling, frozen before response access
response_node_jacobian.variation_requirement: on response nodes, max(H)-min(H) >= sqrt(binary64_epsilon)*max(1,max(abs(H))) for pressure and temperature separately
response_node_jacobian.weighting: unweighted by response uncertainties, but evaluated using response-fitted b_P and b_T; it is not response-independent conditioning evidence

nuisance_contract.scale_solution: b=max(0,sum(w*phi*y)/sum(w*phi^2)) independently for P_SZ and T_X at each shared zeta
nuisance_contract.shared_boundary_ratio_diagnostic: record eta=zeta/(1-zeta) when zeta<1; zeta=1 is the candidate-neutral constant-pressure boundary and is ineligible

predictor_only_input_mapping.candidate_shape_normalization: f_c_shape=f_c/max(f_c) on predictor nodes before H_c integration; reject nonfinite or nonpositive maximum
predictor_only_input_mapping.q: NE/max(NE) within the predictor density profile
predictor_only_input_mapping.s: abs(d ln(NE)/d ln(RW_X)) using one-sided endpoint and centered interior finite differences
predictor_only_input_mapping.x: RW_X/max(RW_X) within the predictor density profile

score_contract.sparc_metric_and_mapping: unchanged from bound V2 and Item61 lineage
score_contract.strict_comparator_rule: candidate primary metric must be strictly lower than each preregistered comparator separately in its domain: SPARC Newtonian and RAR; X-COP gas-only Newtonian shape and uniform-acceleration shape control
score_contract.weighting: equal object then equal observable then equal row
score_contract.xcop_covariance: released diagonal errors with the frozen 5 percent floor; no joint density-pressure-temperature or calibration covariance is claimed

selection_and_ablation.ablation_construction: unchanged from V2: lexicographically first committed raw representative, replace only the named channel by its frozen neutral element, canonicalize without response access
selection_and_ablation.canonical_candidate_order: ascending class_id from the committed 60-class registry
selection_and_ablation.selection_rule: If eligible candidates exist, choose the ascending class_id first; otherwise select none and retain every failure and tie.

shape_structure_gates.derivative: for every adjacent predictor segment, (H[j+1]-H[j])/(x[j+1]-x[j])=-0.5*(q[j]*f[j]+q[j+1]*f[j+1])<0 within tol_d
shape_structure_gates.failure_action: mark the formula-object evaluation structurally ineligible; retain diagnostic and do not prune the family from one object
shape_structure_gates.pressure_slope: for eligible zeta<1 and b_P>0, P_SZ_hat is nonincreasing outward on ordered response nodes within tol_P
shape_structure_gates.temperature_slope: no fixed sign is required because T_X_hat= b_T*phi/q and q may vary
shape_structure_gates.tolerance: tol_H=64*binary64_epsilon*max(1,max(abs(H))); tol_d and tol_P use the same 64*epsilon relative construction in their respective units

composition_coefficient.definition: mean mass per thermal gas particle in proton-mass units, not mean mass per electron
composition_coefficient.shape_effect: constant coefficient is absorbed by b_P and b_T and cannot change H_c curvature

shape_output_mapping.coupling_level: shared radial boundary-shape parameter zeta and shared H_c; separate observable scales only
shape_output_mapping.integration_rule: reverse cumulative trapezoid on predictor x nodes; H_c(1)=0

response_interpolation.H: linear interpolation in H versus x
response_interpolation.q: linear interpolation in log(q) versus log(x)

shape_output_mapping.why_physical_normalizations_cancel: The shared zeta profiles the boundary-to-integrated-drop shape ratio. Separate positive b_P and b_T absorb the unavoidable released P500 and T500 scales without reading them. Pressure and temperature remain coupled through the same zeta and H_c/q curvature.

xcop_comparator_contract.common_shape_normalization: each comparator f is divided by its positive maximum on predictor nodes before the same H=integral_x^1(q*f)du mapping; multiplicative acceleration amplitude is intentionally unidentifiable

gas_only_newtonian_shape.integration_rule: cumulative trapezoid of q*u^2 on predictor x nodes after the analytic constant-density inner term
gas_only_newtonian_shape.stellar_handling: no stellar profile is opened or used; this is explicitly gas-only and not a full baryonic Newtonian prediction

xcop_comparator_contract.matched_complexity: both X-COP controls, every B+E+N candidate, and every ablation use the identical shared zeta,b_P,b_T coupled nuisance contract and identical score; no comparator is selected or changed after response access

uniform_acceleration_shape_control.role: target-independent zero-curvature acceleration control, not a physical dark-matter or modified-gravity model

xcop_comparator_contract.why_empirical_rar_is_not_an_xcop_control: RAR requires the absolute y=g_bar/a0. With permitted q=NE/max(NE) and x=RW_X/max(RW_X), the source-strength factor G*mu_e*m_p*NE_max*R_scale/a0 is unavailable without R500 or an extra response-profiled source-strength nuisance. Neither may be chosen after targets, so RAR is excluded from X-COP V3.
